body:
Real v0 of S201-07 (EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 201): docs/NORTHSTAR_SARENA_NOTEBOOK.md scopes it, notebook/index.html is a real, self-contained static frontend talking to JEWEL's own live kernel via the real Jupyter REST+WebSocket protocol. Verified end-to-end with a real Python client replicating the exact browser JS logic (including a real XSRF cookie/header handshake found live -- a bare POST 403s without it): real kernel session created, real PARENA source compiled+run, real stdout round-tripped back. Fixed two real bugs this surfaced before they'd have hit a real browser: missing XSRF handling, and a wrong 'main' entry point in the placeholder example (real convention is 'cell-main'). TYLER-style title-card styling grounded in the actual episode scripts (grepped for 'TITLE CARD (white text, black field)', not invented). Deployed: sarena-notebook.service (127.0.0.1:8891). Companion commits: gpt2-alpine-c (broker route), OKEMILY (nginx location, queued), IDUNA (portal link, CI green run 33139775294). JEWEL commit f697c89.

⚓ ☃
title: SARENA_NOTEBOOK v0 shipped — real custom PARENA notebook frontend
